blocks.text: Review personally before asking for critique

Read your Lesson 2.2 draft beside its intended purpose and audience. Under every CLEAR category, name a finding and a reason. Correct checks facts and instructions; Listener checks audience fit; Enough checks gaps and repetition; Appropriate checks tone and setting; Responsible checks privacy, fairness, risk, authority and accountability.
Separate an attractive sentence from a supported claim. Mark approvals, dates and promises that could change a decision. Check whether the reader can act without guessing.

Ask your own AI assistant to examine the same five categories using only authorized material. Compare its suggestions with your personal findings. Accept, revise or reject each important suggestion with a reason.
A model reviewing its own output is not independent evidence. Agreement from another model also does not establish an internal promise. Check the actual source.

Write the exact claim and identify a source with authority over it. Compare scope, conditions, version and exceptions. Record the source and the actual check date. Protect private records by saving only an authorized citation or necessary extract.
A five-day delivery promise requires confirmed capacity for that job. A general statement about typical delivery cannot supply that approval. Verify, qualify accurately or remove an uncertain claim.
Revise and retain the approval boundary
Correct the unsupported meaning, audience tone and missing action. Recheck all five CLEAR categories after editing. Name the person with authority to approve wording and any commitments.

Obtain human approval before real use. If approval remains pending, retain a reviewed draft awaiting approval. Label fictional approval routes as simulated. Save the before version, checks, revision and limits in Prompt and Communication Evidence.
A polished proposal promises capacity that has not been confirmed

FICTIONAL TRAINING EXAMPLE: “Your estimate is approved; delivery is guaranteed in five days. Supply the outstanding specifications immediately.” The fictional intake record confirms only review within two business days after complete inputs arrive. Room dimensions and a preferred appointment date are missing. Appointment booking requires the scheduling owner’s approval. Estimate approval and delivery capacity are not confirmed.

blocks.title: Revised fictional example
blocks.text: Thank you for your estimate request. Please reply with the room dimensions and your preferred appointment date. After we receive complete information, our team will review your request within two business days. We will confirm the estimate and schedule after the appropriate review. No appointment or delivery date is confirmed by this message.
Practice with your own AI assistant

blocks.title: Approved CLEAR critique request
blocks.text: Critique this draft under Correct, Listener, Enough, Appropriate and Responsible. Flag unsupported claims and missing information. Do not assert that facts are verified. Draft and approved sources: [inputs].
